Please read this before you travel
Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers need to know that every companion animal journey with Aurelia Skyways begins with careful review and calm preparation. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help you understand the steps, share the required details, and keep the process clear and respectful.

Please bring accurate travel information and respond promptly to any request from the desk so we can support your booking without delay. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. If your pet has special care needs, tell us as soon as possible so the team can prepare suitable guidance and handle the handover with attention. The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, and our staff will always aim to give concise and kind advice.

When you arrive, follow the instructions given by the desk and keep your pet calm and secure. Clear communication helps protect the comfort of every traveler and animal in our care.
